──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Vec<String>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC Config {\n    /// Expand all tilde (~) paths to absolute paths using $HOME.\n    ///\n    /// This must be called after deserialization to ensure all paths\n    /// like `~/.needle` are expanded to `/home/user/.needle`.\n    /// Paths without tildes are left unchanged.\n    pub fn expand_tildes(&mut self) {\n        // workspace section\n        self.workspace.default = expand_tilde_pathbuf(&self.workspace.default);\n        self.workspace.home = expand_tilde_pathbuf(&self.workspace.home);\n\n        // agent section\n        self.agent.adapters_dir = expand_tilde_pathbuf(&self.agent.adapters_dir);\n\n        // strands.explore section\n        self.strands.explore.workspace_root = expand_tilde_pathbuf(&self.strands.explore.workspace_root);\n        self.strands.explore.workspaces = expand_tilde_vec_pathbuf(&self.strands.explore.workspaces);\n\n        // strands.weave section\n        self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces =\n            expand_tilde_vec_pathbuf(&self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces);\n\n        // strands.splice section\n        self.strands.splice.report_workspace =\n            expand_tilde_option_pathbuf(&self.strands.splice.report_workspace);\n\n        // strands.pulse.scanners[].command paths are strings, not PathBuf, so skip\n\n        // strands.reflect section - no PathBuf fields\n\n        // strands.learning section\n        self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file =\n            expand_tilde_pathbuf(&self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file);\n\n        // telemetry section\n        if let Some(ref mut log_dir) = self.telemetry.file_sink.log_dir {\n            *log_dir = expand_tilde_pathbuf(log_dir);\n        }\n\n        // health section\n        self.health.heartbeat_dir = expand_tilde_option_pathbuf(&self.health.heartbeat_dir);\n\n        // supervisor section\n        self.supervisor.heartbeat_path = expand_tilde_option_pathbuf(&self.supervisor.heartbeat_path);\n        self.supervisor.socket_path = expand_tilde_option_pathbuf(&self.supervisor.socket_path);\n\n        // prompt section\n        self.prompt.context_files = expand_tilde_vec_pathbuf(&self.prompt.context_files);\n\n        // self_modification section\n        self.self_modification.canary_workspace =\n            expand_tilde_pathbuf(&self.self_modification.canary_workspace);\n\n        // prompt.variants[].content_file\n        for variants in self.prompt.variants.values_mut() {\n            for variant in variants {\n                variant.content_file = expand_tilde_pathbuf(&variant.content_file);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ConfigLoader\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and unchanged\npub fn expand_tilde(path: &str) -> String {\n    match std::env::var(\"HOME\") {\n        Ok(home) if path == \"~\" => home,\n        Ok(home) => match path.strip_prefix(\"~/\") {\n            Some(rest) => format!(\"{}/{}\", home, rest),\n            None => path.to_string(),\n        },\n        Err(_) => path.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Expand a leading tilde (~) in a PathBuf to the not set.\nfn expand_tilde_pathbuf(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n    let path_str = path.as_os_str().to_str().unwrap_or(\"\");\n\n    // Check if path starts with ~/ or is exactly ~\n    if path_str == \"~\" {\n        if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n            return PathBuf::from(home);\n        }\n    } else if let Some(rest) = path_str.strip_prefix(\"~/\") {\n        if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n            return PathBuf::from(home).join(rest);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // No tilde or HOME not set, return as-is\n    path.to_path_buf()\n}\n\n///
